# Working with dates and times

## Parsing dates with time zones

```{R}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
```

```{R}
ymd("20180810")
```

```{R}
ymd("2018-08-10")
```

```{R}
ymd("2018/08/10")
```

```{R}
mdy("10/15/2018")
```

```{R}
dmy("10/08/2018")
```

## Add a time zone

```{R}
ymd("2018-08-10", tz = "Australia/Melbourne")
```

```{R}
ymd("2018-08-10", tz = "Africa/Abidjan")
```

```{R}
ymd("2018-08-10", tz = "America/Anchorage")
```

```{R}
ymd("2018-08-10", tz = "America/Los_Angeles")
```

## Making sense of time zones

```{R}
today()
```

```{R}
today(tz = "America/Los_Angeles")
```

```{R}
now()
```

```{R}
now(tz = "America/Los_Angeles")
```

## Parsing date with times

```{R}
ymd_hms("2018-08-10 10:05:30", tz = "Australia/Melbourne")
```

```{R}
ymd_hms("2018-08-10 10:05:30", tz = "America/Los_Angeles")
```

## Extracting temporal elements

```{R}
wday("2018-08-10")
```

```{R}
wday("2018-08-10", label = TRUE)
```

```{R}
wday("2018-08-10", label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)
```

```{R}
wday("2018-08-10", label = TRUE, week_start = 1)
```

```{R}
month("2018-08-10")
```

```{R}
month("2018-08-10", label = TRUE)
```

```{R}
month("2018-08-10", label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)
```

```{R}
quarter("2018-08-10")
```

```{R}
semester("2018-08-10")
```

```{R}
yday("2018-08-10") # count how many days in a year have occurred for a date

```

## Case study: pedestrian data in Melbourne

```{R}
ped_melb.south.bourke <- read_csv("ped_melb.south.bourke.csv")
```

```{R}
# Create year, month and wday variable
ped_melb.south.bourke <- ped_melb.south.bourke %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(Date_Time),
    month = month(Date_Time, label = TRUE,
                  abbr = TRUE),
    wday = wday(Date_Time, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE, week_start = 1)
  )

# Create Date column
ped_melb.south.bourke$Date <- as.Date(ped_melb.south.bourke$Date_Time)

ped_melb.south.bourke
```

```{R}
# filter for 2018 and the sensor, Melbourne Centrall
ped <- ped_melb.south.bourke %>%
  filter(
    year == 2018,
    Sensor == "Melbourne Central"
  )

ped
```

```{R}

```

## A first look at the counts

```{R}
library(scales)

# Bar plot of total pedestrian count of each month of 2018
ped %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = Count)) +
  geom_col() + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma)
```

```{R}
# Bar plot of total pedestrian count of each weekday of 2018
ped %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = wday, y = Count)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma)
```

```{R}
ped %>% 
  group_by(Date_Time) %>% 
  summarise(Total_Count = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{R}
ped_daily <- ped %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(Total_Count = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE))

ped_daily %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = Total_Count)) + 
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Distribution of counts

### Hour of the day

```{R}
ped %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Time), y = Count)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(0, 23, by = 6))
```

### Day of the week

```{R}
ped %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = wday, y = Count)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```

### Month of the year

```{R}
ped %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = Count)) + 
  geom_boxplot()
```

```{R}
ped %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Count, group = Date)) +
  geom_line()
```

```{R}
ped %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Count, group = Date)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~month)
```

```{R}
ped %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = Count, group = Date)) + 
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(month ~ wday)
```

## Calendar plots

```{R}
library(sugrrants)
```

```{R}
p1 <- ped %>%
  frame_calendar(
    x = Time,
    y = Count,
    date = Date,
    nrow = 4
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = .Time, y = .Count, group = Date)) + 
  geom_line()

prettify(p1)
```

```{R}
library(tsibble)
library(timeDate)
```

```{R}
vic_holidays <- holiday_aus(2018, state = "VIC")

ped <- ped %>%
  mutate(
    holiday = ifelse(Date %in% vic_holidays$date | wday %in% c("Sat", "Sun"), "yes", "no")
  )

p1 <- ped %>% 
  frame_calendar(x = Time, y = Count, date = Date, nrow = 4) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = .Time, y = .Count, group = Date, colour=holiday)) +
  geom_line() + 
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

prettify(p1)
```
